postmarginal.note: postmarginal() never uses the stratification term a (last element of est): the residual variance is varbetahat alone

preprocessing.note: Row order of the result = order of the input rows that match the LD table (base::merge, sort = FALSE). filter = TRUE keeps N >= 0.67 * quantile(N, 0.9) (R type-7 quantile over ALL input rows), then SNPs in w_hm3.noMHC.snplist, then Z^2 <= 80; NA rows are removed only when MORE THAN ONE value is NA (`if(length(inx)>1)`), so a single NA z or n survives into the model inputs.

two_NA_n_filter_TRUE.error_message: missing values and NaN's not allowed if 'na.rm' is FALSE

stochastic.note: Seeded single runs of upstream's RNG-based functions. They depend on R's RNG stream and are only suitable for statistical sanity comparisons.

projection_CI_m3_height.v_note: v3 is the asymmetric matrix printed in examples.md; MASS::mvrnorm uses eigen(symmetric = TRUE), i.e. only its lower triangle

stochastic.projection_CI_negative_a_note: est with a < 0: projection() takes log(est) for the bootstrap, so the `a` slot is NaN (warning 'NaNs produced'); the run still completes because the power integrals never use a. (est and v are deliberately mismatched here; only the behaviour matters.)
stochastic.projection_CI_a_zero_note: a == 0 exactly (what upstream returns with stratification = FALSE): log(0) = -Inf and 1/est = Inf enter the bootstrap covariance
